title: Baby in Wicker Bassinet, Porch Brick Wall - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet black-and-white snapshot capturing a tiny infant lying in a woven wicker bassinet lined with soft bedding. The baby, dressed in light garments, rubs its face or stretches gently. The bassinet is positioned outside or on an enclosed porch next to an exposed dark brick wall and a multi-pane window. The photograph features decorative scalloped deckle edges characteristic of mid-20th-century home photography.
